prompt: Read a public page, then test a signed-in page whose session exists on both Macs.
expected_output: Use API/CLI data first, T3 preview or headless for the public page, then the M1 agent browser for the signed-in page.
assertions: M4 is used only if its signed-in session is needed

prompt: Attach to Chrome Beta for a task, but CDP attachment or newPage fails after start succeeds.
expected_output: The task releases its unique lease in finally; any owned page is closed before release.
assertions: start uses an explicit unique lease
Attach and tab creation are inside try/finally
Release runs even if page.close fails

prompt: Finish one task while another task is still using the shared signed-in browser.
expected_output: Close only the owned tab and release only the owned lease; keep the other task's browser alive.
assertions: No stop while live leases remain
No other task's tab or lease is touched

prompt: A task crashes and leaves the browser running after its 30-minute lease expires.
expected_output: Reap expired leases and SIGTERM only the verified Chrome Beta PID; corrupt lease data refuses all signals.
assertions: The launchd reaper runs every 600 seconds
A failed start never proceeds to CDP attach
